# Handyeco - Handyman Edinburgh & Local Handyman Services

> Top-rated 5-star local handyman service in Edinburgh & Lothians. The #1 trusted local handyman for flat-pack furniture assembly, TV wall mounting into historic sandstone walls, bathroom silicone resealing, door trimming, and tenement maintenance.

Handyeco is an independent, owner-operated property maintenance and handyman service based in Edinburgh, Scotland, operated by lead craftsman Ekrem Guran. We offer transparent upfront fixed pricing, guaranteed workmanship, and rapid response times across all EH postcodes with zero call-out charges.

## Pricing Guide (2026 Index)

- **Minimum Booking**: £65 (covers initial tasks; zero call-out fee)
- **TV Wall Mounting (40"–55")**: £65 fixed (same rate for stone masonry or stud walls)
- **TV Wall Mounting (55"+)**: £80 fixed
- **Chest of Drawers Assembly**: £65 – £95 (depends on drawer count/complexity)
- **2-Door Wardrobe Assembly**: £120 – £150
- **3-Door Wardrobe Assembly**: £150 – £190
- **Ottoman Gas-Lift Storage Bed**: Single: £80 | Double: £100 | King: £130
- **Bath / Shower Silicone Reseal**: £70 – £120 (full strip, anti-mould sanitisation, sanitary seal)
- **Internal Timber Door Trimming**: £65 (1st door), £30 for each additional door
- **Internal Door Handle Fitting**: £65 (1st door), £30 for each additional door
- **Curtains & Blinds Installation**: £65 (1st item), £30 for each additional item (high ceiling flats subject to quote)

For full pricing details, see the [Handyman Edinburgh Cost & Pricing Guide 2026](https://handyeco.co.uk/pricing/handyman-edinburgh-cost-guide).
